full_judgment:
A M Mahmudur Rahman, J: This appeal by leave at the instance of the appellant, Bangladesh Bar Council, is directed against the judgment and order dated November 5, 1997 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 3450 of 1996 setting aside the judgment of affirmance of the courts below and thereby decreeing the suit. 

 3. The suit was dismissed on contest and the appeal against the decree of the trial court was also dismissed. The plaintiff against the judgment and decree of the lower appellate court moved the High Court Division in revision and the rule issued in Civil Revision No. 3450 of 1996 was made absolute by a Division Bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order, setting aside the judgments of the courts below and thereby decreed the suit. 

 9. For the aforesaid reasons, the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division is set aside and the judgments and decrees of the courts below are restored and the suit is dismissed.
